decisions.reason: The firm has already given this product sustained standalone visibility and it fits its engineering-led, customizable drainage portfolio, so an escalation-of-commitment logic favors continuing rather than admitting a misstep.
This product became more prominently presented after launch and is highly central to the firm's declared move toward integrated floor-level shower solutions, which makes management likely to persist.

Although its website prominence seems to have softened, it still supports the strategically important design-oriented shower drainage line and prior development effort encourages continued commitment.

A shower element with integrated slope closely matches the firm's stated direction toward installation-friendly integrated bathroom systems, so management would be inclined to retain it despite limited web emphasis.
The firm publicly highlighted and explicitly claimed development of this product, including home-page exposure, so sunk investment and visible commitment strongly support keeping it.

This product received only limited website attention, appears less central to the firm's core strategic push in integrated shower drainage, and therefore offers the weakest basis for escalation-driven continuation.
